v6.8.0.released_hint: Some features moved to plugins; upgrade with care
hint: Some built-in features are now provided by independent plugins (such as OCR, barcode recognition, OpenCV, OpenCC, Pinyin, MediaInfo, the terminal and offline project documentation); install and enable the corresponding plugins in the Plugin Center before use
The target SDK of packaged apps changes from 29 to 37; shared storage and local network access require permissions according to system requirements
When packaged apps use images or other features that depend on OpenCV, select the OpenCV plugin when packaging
The console element and floating console now display logs from the current script; global logs are available through the globalconsole element or the log page
File logging now uses a built-in implementation, retaining documented configuration options and common PatternLayout formats; other Log4j APIs are no longer available
Node.js pinyin/pinyin4j and console window controls now call the host asynchronously; scripts must await their results
feature: Desktop shortcuts support automatic archiving of new and pre-existing pinned shortcuts, backup export/import and batch restoration; unreadable icons can be chosen individually or filled with defaults in bulk without replacing saved icons; missing shortcuts after unfreezing are shown on the shortcut backup page without home page prompts, and recognized manual removals are not selected by default; copies of the same script keep separate original IDs (existing shortcut discovery requires Android 7.1+, automatic detection requires Android 8+) (entry: Settings > Configuration > Shortcut backup)

Setup wizard, for running the permission wizard and plugin installation wizard in sequence, with an entry in the home page welcome prompt after first launch (entry: Settings > Configuration > Setup wizard)

Permission wizard, for selecting permissions from the home drawer and requesting them in sequence, with built-in "Standard"/"Minimal"/"All" profiles and custom profiles; granted permissions can be hidden through the menu (entry: Setup wizard/the button in the home drawer's "Permissions" group heading)

Plugin installation wizard, for selecting official plugins by category and installing them in batches, with built-in "Standard"/"Minimal"/"All" profiles and support for saving, renaming and deleting custom profiles (entry: Setup wizard/the floating button menu on the home Plugins tab/the Plugin Center's "+" menu)

Plugin installation wizard supports installing while downloading, silent installation through the 3-Setup Installer plugin with Shizuku/Root/Dhizuku authorization, and checking permission to install unknown apps before downloading when using the system installer

"Show launcher icon" switch in plugin settings (enabled by default), with a shared setting in the plugin installation wizard for icons of plugins newly installed in the current batch (changing app components requires Root or Shizuku)

Accessibility service manager, supporting starting/stopping services, clearing caches, self-checks, event monitoring and copying diagnostic information (entry: Accessibility service item in the home drawer)
Process exit records and copying diagnostic information in Developer options (Android 11+) (entry: long-press the app icon on the About app and developer page)
"Allow Inspector for Node.js scripts" switch in Developer options (disabled by default), for breakpoint debugging and CPU/heap profiling with the Node.js Runtime plugin

Code generation model management page, supporting local import, on-demand downloads, management and comparison of multiple versions, and updates to official models (entry: Settings > Accessibility service > Code generation models)
MCP Server plugin, for accessing AutoJs6 script, file and device operations through MCP clients (entry: home drawer/Plugin Center)
3-Shell Terminal plugin, providing terminal capabilities (entry: home drawer, project toolbar, file manager directory menu)
Node.js Runtime plugin, for running Node.js files and projects (supports the "nodejs" mode directive and .node.js/.cjs/.mjs files)
Python Runtime plugin, for running Python files and projects, with module entry points, execution timeouts and preset standard input
Lua Runtime plugin, for running Lua scripts
Java Runtime and Kotlin Runtime plugins, for compiling and running Java/Kotlin source code (Java requires Android 7+, Kotlin requires Android 8+)
QuickJS Runtime plugin, for running JavaScript files and ES modules (supports the "quickjs"/"qjs" mode directives and .quickjs.js/.quickjs.mjs files)
Bun Runtime plugin, for running JavaScript/TypeScript files and projects (supports the "bun" mode directive and .bun.js/.bun.ts/.bun.tsx files)
TypeScript Engine plugin, for compiling TypeScript files and projects for Rhino/Node.js, with type checking and Source Map support
ai module, for accessing local or online models through AI Provider plugins (such as Three Stone AI), with streaming output, persistent sessions and structured JSON results (see Sample code > ai)

ai.agent script API, for starting, querying, responding to, confirming and cancelling Three Stove Agent tasks, with detached background tasks (requires the Three Stove Agent plugin) (see Sample code > agent)
plan option for ai.agent.run/create, for having Three Stove Agent propose a step-by-step plan before execution in plan mode

compose module, for building interfaces with Jetpack Compose, providing node factories, long-lived node handles, reactive state/render/ref and theme control (requires the 3-Block Compose plugin) (see Sample code > 3-Block Compose)

ui-mode layout preview service, which lets the 3-Block Compose designer preview XML layouts on its canvas with the host's real layout inflater, embedded on Android 11 and later and as a snapshot on older versions (requires 3-Block Compose plugin 1.6.0 or later)

compose.dialog method, for creating updatable and closable dialog and modal bottom sheet sessions in UI or ordinary scripts

flow module and waitAsync global method, for asynchronous waiting and chained operations, with branches, loops, timeouts, retries and cancellation (see Project documentation > [Flow](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/flow))
